use_policy: Reserve exact dimensions for frozen evaluation. Do not use motion outcomes on these objects to tune the generator or correction method. Record and retire/version a reservation if used during development. Static construction and import checks do not evaluate motion.
limitations: Five distinct dimension sets across three primitive shape families, not five independent shape classes
Analytic convex boxes, sphere and cylinders only; no arbitrary mesh, concave, deformable or articulated object coverage
Generic opposing X-axis anchors are geometric references, not certified reachable grips
Scene placement, task contacts, partner interactions, mass/material/physics, baseline/method and remaining release gates are not yet frozen
No exact historical geometry-exposure inventory or checkpoint-training independence claim
No motion, semantic, animator-cleanup or release evidence
